names_note: no matrix lists these tips; list = the printed abbreviations, as printed with their full stops
gold_note: Oviraptorosaur summary tree, 11 tips, fully resolved. Root at the bottom of the vertical trunk; Caud. and Avim. branch off its lower end, Micr. and the Anzu./Anom./Giga. clade at its top, and the oviraptorid branch leaves the trunk part-way up. Several tips (Conc., Wula., Anom.) sit on short vertical stalks directly above their nodes. Tip names are the printed abbreviations, which no matrix lists. Random-sample case (seed 20261106); the only slanted figure with a time axis left in the census. Topology transcribed from the figure and checked node by node at 3x; topology only.
